minimize_note: afl-cmin/afl-showmap do not feed the aflpp shared-memory testcase to persistent LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput harnesses (all inputs yield an identical trace), so coverage-based cmin collapses the corpus to 1. Seeds are instead hash-deduplicated; the parser corpora are hand-curated distinct samples from framework/data_files (diverse by construction, not near-duplicates).

seed_validation: all seeds run clean (exit 0) through the normal and ASAN harnesses; generated seeds are valid by construction (handshakes completed; session/context blobs round-tripped). Coverage-validated 2026-07-26: each added seed was replayed through a coverage build and kept only if it covered lines the existing corpus did not.

Both dictionaries verified to load via afl-fuzz -x.
